```yaml
name: Publish Connectors Prerelease Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'PR Number'
        required: true
        type: number

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Get PR details
        id: get_pr_details
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=pr_branch::$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
          echo "::set-output name=pr_sha::$(git rev-parse HEAD)"

      - name: Post start comment
        id: post_start_comment
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}
          message: "Publishing pre-release connectors for PR #${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }} (branch: ${{ steps.get_pr_details.outputs.pr_branch }}, SHA: ${{ steps.get_pr_details.outputs.pr_sha }}). Please wait for the build to complete."

      - name: Call publish_connectors.yml workflow
        id: call_publish_connectors
        uses: ./.github/workflows/publish_connectors.yml
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
          release-type: pre-release

      - name: Post completion comment
        id: post_completion_comment
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}
          message: "Connector pre-release build completed. Status: ${{ job.status }}"
```
